lines.en: I spend the morning walking around town with Touka, pointing out and explaining various things that she has never before seen.
lines.zh: 我陪 Touka 在镇上逛了一上午，指给她看、并解释各种她从没见过的东西。

lines.en: It's a bit like hanging out with a child, except this particular child is old enough to reproduce and push out an {i}actual{/i} child that will emerge with a silver spoon in hand.
lines.zh: 有点像陪小孩玩——只不过这个「小孩」已经大到能生育、能生出一个「含着银汤匙」降生的{i}真{/i}小孩了。

lines.en: But even though each and every one of her actions is tinged with a hint of naivete, there's an overwhelming feeling of her desire to learn and to understand.
lines.zh: 不过，尽管她的一举一动都透着天真，却能强烈感觉到她「想学、想懂」的渴望。

lines.en: To cultivate her knowledge of the outside world and grow into a human being that is both financially blessed and socially adored.
lines.zh: 想增长对外面世界的见识，成长为一个既有钱、又受人爱戴的人。

lines.en: And while I still think it may be too soon to cite that desire as selflessness, I can't help but feel as if her good sides are forcing back her bad ones.
lines.zh: 尽管我仍觉得，现在就把那份渴望称作「无私」还为时过早，但我忍不住觉得，她好的一面正在压过她坏的一面。

lines.en: And that, one day, she will become everything she wants to be.
lines.zh: 而且，总有一天，她会成为她想成为的一切。

lines.en: Or die in the process, because living isn't that easy.
lines.zh: 要么，在这过程中死去——因为活着没那么容易。
